description_text: Proposed procurement for NSN 5920013523625 STRAP,WRIST,ELECTRO: Line 0001 Qty 444 UI EA Deliver To: By: 0022 DAYS ADO This Solicitation may result in an Automated IDC (Indefinite Delivery Contract). The term of the contract/order will be one year or until the aggregate total of orders placed against the contract/order reach 350000.00. The estimated number of orders per year is 5. The Guaranteed Minimum quantity will be 66. Items will be shipped to various CONUS and OCONUS (via consolidation and containerization point) DLA Depots. Approved sources are 0YBM6 220-012; 1MH97 2224; 5K923 5055-12; 62576 9028 AND 9680. The solicitation is an RFQ and will be available at the link provided in this notice. Hard copies of this solicitation are not available. Specifications, plans, or drawings are not available. All responsible sources may submit a quote which, if timely received, shall be considered. Quotes must be submitted electronically.
